summary: Gives guidance on when a Label Distribution Protocol (LDP) router should implement a restart mechanism and which approach suits which situation. It is an applicability statement, so it advises rather than defining new protocol machinery. It covers the restart issues also relevant to constraint-based LSP setup in RFC 3212.

eli5.summary: When a worker takes a quick break, you want the factory line to keep moving. This note helps decide when network routers need a plan to keep traffic flowing while one restarts, and which plan fits best.

questions: when to use ldp graceful restart
